english_title: 26. His Supplication for Neighbours and Friends

phrases.english: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَتَـوَلَّنِي فِي جيرَانِي وَمَوَالِيَّ وَالْعَارِفِينَ بحَقِّنَا وَالْمُنَابِذِينَ لأِعْدَائِنَا بِأَفْضَلِ وَلاَيَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 2.and attend to me with Your best attending in my neighbours and friends who recognize our right and war against our enemies!
3.Give [my neighbours and friends] success in performing Your prescriptions

phrases.arabic: وَالأَخْذِ بِمَحَاسِنِ أَدَبِكَ فِي إرْفَاقِ ضَعِيفِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 4.and taking on the beauties of Your courtesy through acting gently with their weak,
5.remedying their lacks, visiting their sick,
6.guiding their seeker of right guidance, giving good counsel to their seeker of advice,
7.attending to the one among them who returns from travel, hiding their secrets,
8.covering over their shameful things, helping their wronged,
9.sharing kindly with them in goods,
10.turning toward them with wealth and bestowal of bounty,

phrases.arabic: وَإعْطَآءِ مَـا يَجِبُ لَهُمْ قَبْلَ السُّؤالِ
phrases.english: 11.and giving what is due to them before they ask!
12.Let me, O God, repay their evildoer with good-doing,
13.turn away from their wrongdoer with forbearance.

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَعْمِلْ حُسْنَ الظّنِّ فِي كَافَّتِهِمْ، وَأَتَوَلَّى بِالْبِرِّ عَامَّتَهُمْ،
phrases.english: 14.have a good opinion of every one of them, attend to all of them with devotion,
15.lower my eyes before them in continence,
16.make mild my side toward them in humility,

phrases.arabic: وَأَرِقُّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَلاءِ مِنْهُمْ رَحْمَةً،
phrases.english: 17.be tender toward the afflicted among them in mercy,
18.make them happy in absence through affection,
19.love that they continue to receive favour through good will,
20.grant them what I grant my next of kin,
21.and observe for them what I observe for my special friends!
22.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
23.provide me the like of that from them,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي أَوْفَى الْحُظُوظِ فِيمَا عِنْدَهُمْ ،
phrases.english: 24.appoint for me the fullest share of what is with them,

phrases.arabic: وَزِدْهُمْ بَصِيْرَةً فِي حَقِّي، وَمَعْرِفَةً بِفَضْلِي،
phrases.english: 25.increase them in insight toward my right and knowledge of my excellence
26.so that they will be fortunate through me and I fortunate through them!
27.Amen, Lord of the worlds!
